rows.note: This is the everyday spoken choice for one actual apology or saying sorry.

example.english: I’ve already made an apology, but you still won’t forgive me.
example.traditional: 我已經講咗一句對唔住，你仲唔肯原諒我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gong2 zo2 jat1 geoi3 deoi3 m4 zyu6 nei5 zung6 m4 hang2 jyun4 loeng6 ngo5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an apology, especially when describing or referring to the act formally.

example.english: This letter is the company’s formal apology.
example.traditional: 呢封信係公司正式嘅道歉。
example.jyutping: ni1 fung1 seon3 hai6 gung1 si1 zing3 sik1 ge3 dou6 hip3
